# [TASK] Tests and docs: bilingual voice control

## Task
Round out test coverage and update docs for bilingual voice control.

## Scope
Coverage gaps left after #211-#214's own inline tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Integration test exercises the full pipeline (language switch -> transcription -> intent parsing -> command dispatch) for both languages (`AiServiceIntegrationTest.fullPipelineTranscribesAndClassifiesEnglishTranscript`, `fullPipelineTranscribesAndClassifiesGermanTranscript`; `VoiceControl.pipeline.test.jsx`'s English and German end-to-end tests)
- [x] `backend/ai-service/README.md`'s "Supported Voice Commands" section updated with German phrasing and the language switch (`backend/ai-service/README.md`, lines 58-61)
- [x] JaCoCo/Istanbul coverage for touched code meets the project threshold (`./gradlew :backend:ai-service:jacocoTestCoverageVerification`, `npm run test:coverage` in `frontend/lmdb`)
- [x] `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` updated for the language-parameterized model loading (`docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` §3.7)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
Closed against commit `b6aebb3`.

Backend tests chain `POST /speech-to-text` into `POST /voice-command` for English and German, asserting via `ArgumentCaptor<Prompt>` that the transcript really reaches the model. `VoiceControl.pipeline.test.jsx` drives the same path on the frontend with only `fetch` mocked.

`/voice-command` requires a JWT; only `/speech-to-text` is public.

Still open under #200: #215 and #229.
